messages:
maria: quick flag  provisioning guide still shows single "labels" param in SDK examples. customers hit surprises when pool bindings override tenant intent. we need a concise precedence note + updated snippets.

samir: agreed. TL;DR: binding_labels take precedence at allocation; tenant_labels are merged for policies. SDKs now expose binding_labels + tenant_labels.

elaine: i'll update the handbook section and fix the moved anchor that broke links from autoscale. can we add a tiny 3-row decision table for clarity?

kevin: please add updated python and go snippets. sample go: ```go
client.CreateReservedCapacity(ctx, CreateReservedCapacityParams{
  TenantID: "acct-123",
  TenantLabels: map[string]string{"env":"prod"},
  BindingLabels: map[string]string{"reserved_tier":"gold"},
  ReservedPool: "gpu-pool-1",
})
```

samir: also include a YAML routing fallback example so on-call knows what happens when preemption/fallback mix: ```yaml
routing:
  - when: pool_preempted
    to: model:opt-6b-quant
    preserve_kv_cache: false
  - when: pool_saturated
    to: model:llama-7b-quant
    preserve_kv_cache: true
```

maria: can someone open a PR with: update python+go snippets, add label precedence subsection, tiny table, YAML example, and anchor fix + a small render test to assert anchor exists?

elaine: i'll open it this afternoon and add a CI link-check job.

dev-docs-bot: link-check queued for branch/patch/provisioning-labels-177777. report will be posted.

kevin: reviewed PR, left two wording nits. approved after those.

maria: merged. deployed. filing internal KB note and pinging SDK owners to sync the reference page.

samir: noted. closing loop with support. ticket KB-10123.

maria: thanks everyone. archiving when release notes are live. :thumbsup:
